# Krishna Naicker — personal portfolio

Personal portfolio of Krishna Naicker, a full-stack AI engineer based in Pune, India. He builds agent orchestration platforms, retrieval systems, and web applications, and currently leads Orkus at AllCognix AI.

## Pages

- Work: five projects — AssetFlow, Support Triage Agent, TraceLink, CareFlow & HealBERT, HealthEase — with overview, technologies, and public GitHub links where they exist.
- Experience: two internships (AllCognix AI, Omnineura AI Technologies), and a compact achievements list.
